phone.changelog: v3.3.48: Movies fixed — movibox streams routed through VPS proxy (CDN rejects headerless video requests).

tv.changelog: v3.12.73: Movies & series fixed — movibox CDN hotlink gate (429) handled: native player now sends Referer/UA headers; web/phone playback streams through the VPS proxy. Live channel thumbnails fixed — dead Sony logos repaired, logos served via image proxy with retry. Live channel playback untouched.

android_tv.changelog: v3.12.86: Live TV category sidebar is now fully remote-navigable — LEFT from the channel grid lands on it, UP/DOWN walk through Sports / News / Entertainment / Movies / Kids (previously DOWN bounced back into the grid so only All Channels was reachable). LEFT on the sidebar no longer misfires, and the last row of channels clears the bottom nav. Carries all of v3.12.83-85: real channel logos, StreamFlix structure, dock nav fixes.
